title: Fuel tape rewind
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, and let $m$ be either Boolean mode. Choose a host base configuration, an input-head position, flag and counter tapes, an integer counter-head position, a word $w$, and an output word. For every integer $j$ with $0\le j\le |w|$, a host configuration in phase $1$ with payload tape storing $w$, payload head at $j-1$, and the specified counter head reaches phase $2$ after $j+1$ steps, with the payload tape still storing $w$ and its head at zero; the other specified components are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite Turing machines B and F
